name: Premier Protein 30g Chocolate Shake (WARNING)
whyItWorks: Formulated with milk protein concentrate (retaining residual lactose), carrageenan (a known intestinal barrier disruptor in clinical models), inulin, and artificial gums that frequently induce loose stools and cramping in IBD.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Approach with caution. If sensitive to dairy emulsifiers or carrageenan, choose pure whey isolate or hydrolyzed formulas instead.
